newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Tech to acquire Lawrence in swap.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Tech to acquire Lawrence in swap.

text.p: Advanced Technology Materials Inc said Monday it is in a definitive agreement to acquire Lawrence Semiconductor Laboratories through a stock swap valued at $78 million.
Advanced Technology said in a release that the acquisition is expected to be accretive to 1997 earnings, adding that it expects to recognize transaction-related costs of about $1.5 million.
Advanced Technology said Lawrence Semiconductor had revenue of over $20 million in 1996.
Advanced Technology said the transaction, expected to close in the third quarter of 1997, will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.
About 4.2 million common shares of the new Advanced Technology holding company will be exchanged for the interests in Lawrence Semiconductor, the company said.
However, the company said the final number of shares will not be determined until the date of shareholder approval.
